Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the final innings of this Test! The players have made their way out to the middle. John Campbell and Kraigg Brathwaite are at the crease. Chris Woakes will start with the ball. Here we go...
... Fourth innings ...

It has been another dismal batting performance from England. Their dependence on their skipper, Joe Root was exposed yet again as none of their batters managed to get in and score big. For West Indies, it was the game-changing spell of Kyle Mayers that completely turned the game in Windies' favor. All their bowlers stuck to their task and have ensured that they don't have a mountain to climb in the fourth innings.

So England have only managed to add only 17 more runs to their overnight score. West Indies now need just 28 runs to seal the series now and it should be a cakewalk for them. The Windies bowlers have made sure that the English tail doesn't wag as it did in the first innings. It was Kemar Roach who picked up the remaining two wickets and England now are on the brink of a series defeat.
Review! West Indies have opted for a review for caught behind! The UltraEdge rolls in and it shows a clear spike as the ball passes the bat. The on-field decision needs to be overturned.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Kemar Roach wraps the innings up and Jack Leach fails to survive this time! A fuller ball, outside off, shapes away a tad. Jack Leach looks to push this but manages to get a slight outside edge back to the keeper. Joshua Da Silva takes a good low catch. However, the umpire thinks otherwise and gives it not out. But West Indies opt for a review! The replay does show a spike as the ball passes through the bat and the on-field decision has been overturned. England are all out for 120 and West Indies need 28 runs to win this Test as well as the series.
Commentary.Howout: c Joshua Da Silva b Kemar Roach

Commentary.Commentary: Kemar Roach drops it short now, down the leg side. Saqib Mahmood pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Back-of-a-length delivery, around middle. Jack Leach gets on his toes and defends it out solidly.
Another shorter ball, around middle. Jack Leach presents the full face of the bat and defends it out
Back of a length, around middle. Jack Leach blocks it out.
Another shorter ball, pacey delivery, on the body. Saqib Mahmood looks to pull this, but the ball goes off the outside edge over the fielder at slip. Single taken!
Fuller, outside off. Saqib Mahmood drives it towards mid off.
Another bouncer, around middle. Saqib Mahmood ducks underneath it. The West Indies players think they heard a noise there. But they do no opt for a review.
Slight halt in play. Jack Leach seems to have some issue with his glove. He gets some help from the umpire as well as Jayden Seales.
Wide! Down the leg side, shorter ball. Saqib Mahmood leaves it alone.
Fuller ball now, around off. Jack Leach blocks it out.

In the air....and just short! Oh, dear! That was so close! A shorter ball, outside off. Jack Leach stays in his crease and pushes it towards point. The ball lobs up in the air and lands just short of Alzarri Joseph at point.
On a length, down the leg side. Jack Leach flicks it towards square leg.
Fuller, wide of off. Saqib Mahmood opens the face of the bat and guides it towards point for a single.
Short of a length, angling in from middle. Saqib Mahmood stays back and tucks it to the right of the short leg fielder.
Saqib Mahmood is the last batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! What a wicket this is, a top catch from Jason Holder! Kemar Roach comes into the attack and strikes straightaway, that is his first wicket of the innings. Soft dismissal for Chris Woakes. On a length, down the leg side. Chris Woakes flicks it towards leg slip. Jason Holder stretches his right hand out and grabs it safely. England have lost their ninth wicket now.
Commentary.Howout: c Jason Holder b Kemar Roach

Commentary.Commentary: Kemar Roach comes into the attack now.
Back of a length, around middle and off. Jack Leach sways away and leaves it alone.
On a length, around middle and leg. Jack Leach defends it out.
Well bowled! A yorker now, around middle and off, at 145 clicks. Jack Leach does well to dig this one out.
Fuller, angling in, around middle. Jack Leach knocks it towards mid on.
Back of a length, angling in, around the pads. Jack Leach tucks it toward square leg.
Shorter ball, around off. Jack Leach sways away and leaves it alone.
Full again, around off. Chris Woakes blocks it out solidly.
Tad fuller, wide of off. Chris Woakes defends it out.
On a length, outside off. Chris Woakes looks to play this initially, but he bails out at the end. The ball goes off the bottom of the bat towards gully, who collects the ball on the bounce.
Full again, on middle. Chris Woakes shows the full face of the bat and blocks it out.
Angling in, overpitched delivery, on middle. Chris Woakes drives it towards mid on.
Very full, outside off. Chris Woakes opens the face of the bat and guides it towards cover.
A full ball, angling down leg. Jack Leach misses his flick.
Another ball, shorter in length, around leg. Woakes tucks it to fine leg for a run.

NOT OUT! This was a back-of-a-length ball, around leg. Woakes looks to pull but he misses. The ball hits him on his thigh pad and lobs up towards the short leg fielder. West Indies appeal and the umpire agrees. Woakes opts for a review straightaway and the UltraEdge shows no spike as the ball passed the bat. The on-field decision is overturned!
Review! Chris Woakes has reviewed a catch decision! No bat involved, confirms UltraEdge. Chris Woakes survives and a successful review for him.
On a length, around leg. Jack Leach helps it on its way towards fine leg for a single.
Back of a length, angling in from outside off. Jack Leach leaves it alone.
Joseph comes 'round the wicket and serves a short ball, just outside off. Jack Leach sways away from the line of the ball.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Chris Woakes leaves it alone.
Back of a length, outside off. Woakes leaves it for the keeper to collect.
Mayers hurls a full ball, outside off. Chris Woakes pushes it towards the mid off fielder.
Fuller in length, outside off. Chris Woakes gets forward and blocks it.
On a length, around off. Chris Woakes defends it watchfully.
A length ball, outside off. Chris Woakes leaves it alone.
Short of a length, on middle. Jack Leach misses his flick and gets hit on his thigh pad. Joseph starts with a maiden over!
Shorter in length, outside off. Jack Leach does not bother playing at that one.
Banged into the deck, around middle. Jack Leach covers his off pole and defends it onto the deck.
Short of a length, outside off. Leach lets it be.
Pitches it up, around off. Jack Leach keeps it out.
Joseph comes over the wicket and serves a short ball, angling across the batter. Leach lets it through to the keeper.
Alzarri Joseph comes into the attack. He replaces Jayden Seales.
Good-length delivery, around off. Chris Woakes blocks it out solidly yet again.
On a length, just outside off. Chris Woakes blocks it to cover.
This is a length ball, angling in from off. Chris Woakes defends it off the front foot.
Back of a length, outside off. Chris Woakes leaves it alone.
On a length, around off. Chris Woakes keeps it out.

FOUR! This is a full ball, outside off. Chris Woakes prods and drives it through the cover region. Jermaine Blackwood gives it a chase. He slides just in front of the ropes but his foot touches the ropes while trying to stop the ball. A boundary.
Good-length delivery, around off. Jack Leach blocks it off the front foot.
Aerial but safe! Back of a length, around off. Jack Leach looks to drive on the up but it goes off the outer half of the blade just wide of the bowler.
Another ball, shorter in length and going on with the angle. Jack Leach does not bother playing at that one.
A bumper, around leg. Jack Leach lets it sail through to the keeper.
In the air...but safe! A short ball, around off. Leach hops in his crease and tries to keep it out. It hits the splice of his bat and lobs up just past the short leg fielder.
A short ball, around leg. Woakes sits back and pulls it along the ground towards fine leg for a single.
A full ball, around off. Jack Leach drives it to the short mid off fielder.
Pitches it up, around off. Jack Leach blocks it back to the bowler.
Shorter in length, outside off. Jack Leach punches it through the point region and takes a couple of runs.
Back of a length, around off. Jack Leach keeps it out.
This is another full ball, well outside off. Woakes gets to the pitch of the ball and carves it through the cover region. The batters take three runs.
Mayers starts with a full ball, outside off. Chris Woakes shoulders his arms to it.
Who will bowl from the other end? Kyle Mayers it is.
A short ball, outside off. Jack Leach sways away from the line of the ball.
Back of a length, outside off. Jack Leach lets it through to the keeper.
A bumper, angling down leg. Jack Leach gets inside the line of the ball and leaves it alone.
Short of a length, around leg. Chris Woakes helps it on its way towards fine leg and takes a single. England are underway on Day 4!
Back of a length, way down leg. Chris Woakes lets it through to the keeper.
Seales comes 'round the wicket and serves it on a length, around leg. Chris Woakes misses his flick.
We are set for Day 4 to get underway! The players have made their way out to the middle. Chris Woakes and Jack Leach are at the crease. Jayden Seales will start proceedings with the ball. Let's go!

PITCH REPORT - Mark Butcher and Steven Harmison are near the pitch. The former says that the cracks have opened up a bit and there can be some variable bounce. Harmison says that hitting the right areas is key on this pitch. Butcher says that the pitch hasn't deteriorated much and it has been dry since Day 1.

West Indies have been bossing the game so far and they will be keen to wrap things up early on in the first session of Day 4. Kyle Mayers picked wickets for fun on Day 3 and West Indies require two more wickets to bowl out the opposition. England lead by just 10 runs and they would hope that their tail-enders, along with Chris Woakes stretch the lead as far as possible and give their bowlers something to play with in the last innings. The English side has a tough task in front of them and it is West Indies who are on the brink of clinching the Richards-Botham Trophy. Stay tuned as the live action begins shortly.

Hello and a very warm welcome to the coverage of Day 4 of the final Test match between England and West Indies. This could also turn out to be the last day of this enthralling Test series, unless we see the English tail-enders repeating their heroics of the first innings.
... Day 4, Session 1 ...

Right then! Another intriguing day of Test cricket comes to an end. England's lead is just 10 runs in the second innings, and they have only two wickets in hand to extend their lead. West Indies will be smelling victory from here and will be looking to wrap things up as soon as possible in the first session on Day 4. The first ball of Day 4 will be bowled at 7.30 pm IST (2.00 pm GMT). As you know, our build-up will start well in advance. So do join us for the same. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Kyle Mayers is up for a quick chat. He says that his performance is very special for him. Mentions that straighter deliveries were working for him with variable bounce and movement and he just wanted to make the batters play as much as possible. Informs that Joshua Da Silva's innings was very special, and it was very emotional for him also. Says that he just waited for his turn to play and the opportunity turned in and he grabbed it.

Earlier in the day, it was the pair of Jayden Seales and Joshua Da Silva who frustrated the English bowlers as they stitched together a partnership of 52 runs for the last wicket and ensured that they get a healthy lead. Joshua Da Silva registered his maiden Test hundred, which is also turning out to be a match-winning one for the Windies. Then it was their bowlers, especially Kyle Mayers who kept the English batters on their toes and it was Mayers' spell that completely shifted the match in West Indies' favor. Apart from Alex Lees and Jonny Bairstow, no other batter managed to get into double figures for England, and they now find themselves in deep, deep trouble heading into Day 4.

Well, Day 3 of a Test match is said to be a moving day and this Test has moved at a rate of knots, courtesy of some fine bowling performance from West Indies! They have completely dominated Day 3 and are on the brink of a Test series win heading into Day 4. England's batting woes continued in their second innings and they have only themselves to blame. Kyle Mayers has been the star performer for the Windies and his inclusion in this Test match has turned out to be a terrific decision.
Angling in, around middle, on a length. Jack Leach defends it out. That will be Stumps on Day 3!
Very full on this occasion, around middle. Jack Leach drives it towards mid off.
Another length delivery, angling in, around middle and leg. Jack Leach tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Good-length delivery, around middle and off. Jack Leach defends it out off the back foot.
Angling in, fuller ball, around middle. Jack Leach pushes it towards mid on.
On a length, shaping back in, outside off. Jack Leach leans and tries to block this but he misses.
This is a shorter length ball, around middle. Jack Leach hangs back and tucks it uppishly just past the short leg fielder for a run.
Banged into the deck, outside off. Leach sways away from the line of the delivery.
On a length and angling across the batter from off. Jack Leach lets it sail through to the keeper.
Short of a length, around off. Jack Leach keeps it out.
Another ball, short and around middle. Leach gets on top of the bounce and dabs it onto the deck.
Jack Leach has been struck on his helmet. The physio is out there to conduct the mandatory concussion test. Leach seems fine and we are good to go!

Seales runs in and serves a short ball, around middle. Leach hops in his crease to keep it out with soft hands. The ball hits his glove, then goes onto hit the helmet and lands safely in front of square on the off side.
Jayden Seales (9-2-23-1) is brought back into the attack.
A full ball, outside off. Chris Woakes lets it be. Yet another maiden over from Kyle Mayers, his sixth in total.
Good-length delivery, just outside off. Chris Woakes taps it to the off side.
On a length, outside off. Chris Woakes prods and defends it to cover.
A full ball, outside off. Chris Woakes drives it to the fielder at mid off.
Good-length ball, around middle. Woakes tucks it to mid-wicket.
Good-length ball, just outside off. Chris Woakes tries to block but it goes off the outside edge, along the ground towards the gully fielder.
A length delivery, down the leg side. Jack Leach misses his flick.
Another shorter ball, down the leg side once again. Jack Leach offers no shot. Joshua Da Silva does well to stop the ball.
Down the leg side, short in length. Jack Leach leaves it alone.
Alzarri Joseph drops it short once again, down the leg side. Jack Leach ducks underneath it.
Shorter ball again, down the leg side. Chris Woakes tucks it towards fine leg for a single.
Back of a length, around middle. Chris Woakes leans and ducks underneath it.
Angling in, on a length, outside off. Jack Leach leaves it alone. Another successful over by Kyle Mayers.
Back of a length, around off. Jack Leach keeps it out.
Fuller in length, on middle. Jack Leach pushes it towards mid on.
Pitches it up, around off. Leach defends it to the off side.
Jack Leach is the next batter in.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! There it is! First five-wicket haul for Kyle Mayers! What a game he is having! This is extraordinary stuff from him. England continue to tumble. This was a shorter ball, wide of off, shaping away tad. Craig Overton tries to push thisthrough cover, away from his body, off the back foot. But the ball goes off the outside edge and straight towards Jason Holder at gully. He juggles at first but holds onto it in the end. England are now 8 down.
Commentary.Howout: c Jason Holder b Kyle Mayers

Commentary.Commentary: Kyle Mayers pitches it up, around middle. Kyle Mayers pushes it towards mid-on.
Alzarri Joseph continues to ball short, around the leg stump. Craig Overton tucks it towards square leg for a single. He retains the strike.
Shorter ball, down the leg side. Craig Overton looks to tuck this away, but he misses. The ball brushes off his pad and goes towards the keeper.
Back of a length, around middle and leg. Chris Woakes pulls it towards fine leg and rotates the strike. 100 up for England!
Leg bye! Shorter ball, shaping in, around off. Craig Overton looks to leave this but the ball goes off his forearm towards third man. A leg bye taken!
Good-length delivery, on middle. Craig Overton defends it out solidly.
Down the leg side, tad shorter. Chris Woakes pulls it gently towards deep square leg for a single.
Fullish delivery, around middle and leg. Craig Overton works it away towards mid-wicket.
Fuller in length, down the leg side. Craig Overton looks to flick this but he misses. There was half an appeal for caught behind, but the umpire says no!
Fuller ball, outside off. Craig Overton leaves it alone.
Play and a miss! Back of a length, well outside off. Craig Overton has a poke at it but the ball zips past his outside edge.
Craig Overton walks out to bat now.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! The man with the golden arm, Kyle Mayers strikes once again. The resilience of Alex Lees has now ended. England are 7 down and Kyle Mayers is one wicket away from grabbing a five-wicket haul. The one lands on a length, nipping in just a tad, around middle, the ball stayed low as well. Alex Lees looks to block this but he misses due to the lack of bounce, and the ball sneaks under his bat and goes on to shatter the stumps. England are in deep, deep trouble.
Fuller ball, outside off. Alex Lees defends it out towards cover.
Another short ball, one again down leg. Chris Woakes leaves it alone this time.
Down the leg side again, fraction shorter. Chris Woakes looks to pull but he misses.
Tad shorter, down the leg side. Chris Woakes flicks it towards fine leg. Kyle Mayers runs to his left and stops the ball from touching the boundary ropes. Two taken!
FOUR LEG BYES! Back of a length, down the leg side. Chris Woakes misses his pull shot and the ball deflects off his thigh pad and goes towards fine leg for a boundary. England lead by 2 runs now!
Shorter ball now, around middle. Alex Lees pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Shorter ball, down the leg side. Alex Lees miscues his pull shot towards square leg.
An overpitched ball, on middle. Chris Woakes clips it to the mid-wicket fielder.
Full and outside off. Woakes drives it through the cover region and takes a couple of runs.
A length ball, jagging back in from middle. Chris Woakes tucks it to mid-wicket.
On a length, just outside off. Chris Woakes defends it to the off side.
BEATEN! Good-length delivery, just outside off and staying a tad low. Woakes gets forward to block but the ball goes past his outside edge.
A length ball, around off. Chris Woakes prods and defends it towards cover.
Back of a length, around leg. Woakes wrists it behind square on the leg side with soft hands and collects a single.
A short ball, around leg. Woakes ducks underneath.
Full and outside off. Alex Lees drives it to deep cover and takes a single.
A bumper, around off. Lees pulls it along the ground wide of the deep mid-wicket fielder. The batters take two runs with ease this time.
Back of a length, just outside off. Alex Lees mistimes his pull shot towards the mid-wicket fielder.
A short ball from 'round the wicket, around leg. Chris Woakes hops in his crease and plays it with soft hands past the square leg fielder for a single. He is up and running!
Good-length delivery, around middle. Alex Lees tucks it to mid-wicket. A maiden over from Mayers!
Fuller now, outside off, Alex Lees leaves it alone.
Angling in, on middle, on a length. Alex Lees defends it out.
Tad fuller, around off. Alex Lees looks to block this but the ball goes off the outside edge away from gully.
Shaping away, outside off, on a length. Alex Lees leaves it alone.
On a length, angling in, around middle. Alex Lees defends it out towards mid-wicket.
Chris Woakes makes his way out to bat. Also, Kyle Mayers (7-2-7-3) comes back into the attack.

OUT! RUN OUT! Oh, dear! This is the last thing England wanted at this stage! England are falling into a deeper hole! Absolutely needless running from Ben Foakes and Alex Lees. This was another short ball, around leg. Ben Foakes tucks it behind square on the leg side. He completes the first run with ease and calls for the second run. Kyle Mayers picks the ball in the deep and throws it to the keeper. Joshua Da Silva collects the ball and disturbs the stumps. Ben Foakes dives to get inside the crease but he is well short of his crease. It is all West Indies at the moment and England are falling apart!
Commentary.Howout: run out (Kyle Mayers / Joshua Da Silva)

Commentary.Commentary: Is that a run out? There is a throw at the keeper's end. The replay rolls in and shows that Ben Foakes is short of his ground. His dive could not save him and he walks back to the hut.
Banged into the deck, down leg. Ben Foakes sways away from the line of the ball.
Joesph persists with a short ball, around leg. Alex Lees stays back and just helps it on its way towards fine leg for a run.
A short ball, around leg. Ben Foakes looks to hook it but he mistimes it just past the leg gully fielder for a single. Foakes is off the mark.
Back of a length, on middle. Ben Foakes hangs back and tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Ben Foakes walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Alzarri Joseph provides the breakthrough for West Indies and a set batter departs. A wicket against the run of play and Joseph coming 'round the wicket has done the trick for him. Bairstow tried to up the ante but ends up throwing away his wicket in doing so. Joseph serves a shorter length delivery, angling across the batter. Bairstow looks to pull hard but he only manages an under edge which goes through to the keeper. Joshua Da Silva takes a simple catch and England find themselves in a spot of bother now.
Commentary.Howout: c Joshua Da Silva b Alzarri Joseph

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and quicker, around middle. Alex Lees stays back and punches it to mid on.
Leg bye! This is nicely tossed up, on middle and spinning in late. Jonny Bairstow prods to defend but he misses. The ball hits the pad and lobs up over the short leg fielder for a leg bye.
Floated, on a length, on off. Jonny Bairstow gets to the pitch of the ball and keeps it out.
Around off. Blocked out.
Tossed up, around off. Jonny Bairstow prods and blocks it.
Flatter ball, spinning in from outside off. Jonny Bairstow rocks back and keeps it out.
Fraction shorter again, around middle and off. Alex Lees pushes it towards cover.
Back of a length, down the leg side. Alex Lees lets that go through to the keeper.
Outside off, on a length. Jonny Bairstow taps it towards point for a single.
Short, down the leg side. Jonny Bairstow leaves it alone.
Another back-of-a-length delivery, around middle. Alex Lees pulls this towards square leg. Single taken.
Short of a length, shaping away, outside off. Alex Lees ducks under it and leaves it alone.

DRINKS! The pair of Jonny Bairstow and Alex Lees has done well to keep the Windies bowlers at bay after England lost wickets in quick succession before the Tea break. Although, they still trail by 16 runs and the pair must ensure that they bat till Stumps. For West Indies, they aren't getting much assistance from the surface and their bowlers will need to work hard to pick wickets from hereon.
Tad shorter now, spinning away from the left-hander, outside off. Alex Lees pushes it towards deep point for a single. 2 runs off Jermaine Blackwood's first over!
This one comes in with the angle, around middle and leg. Jonny Bairstow tucks it towards square leg and rotates the strike.
Loopy delivery, full, around off again. Jonny Bairstow defends it out off the front foot.
Tosses it up, full, around off. Jonny Bairstow leans and defends it out.
Fuller, turning in, around off. Jonny Bairstow stays back and pushes it towards cover.
Jermaine Blackwood begins with a quicker one, spinning in, around off. Jonny Bairstow defends it out.
Jermaine Blackwood comes into the attack now.
Alzarri Joseph drops it short once again, down the leg side. Alex Lees looks to pull this but he misses.
On a length, outside off. Jonny Bairstow slashes it towards sweeper cover and rotates the strike.
Back of a length, around middle. Alex Lees pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Alzarri Joseph drops it short again, around middle. Alex Lees ducks underneath it.
Angling in, around middle, touch shorter now. Jonny Bairstow drags it with the inner half of his bat towards square leg for a single.
Leg bye! Fraction shorter now, down the leg side. Alex Lees looks to pull this but he misses. The ball brushes off his pads and rolls towards fine leg. A leg bye taken!
Fuller ball, outside off. Alex Lees leans and drives it past cover. Kraigg Brathwaite chases it and does well to keep it only to a single.
Angling in, on a length, around middle. Alex Lees tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Change of angle for Jason Holder! He goes 'round the wicket now, serves a fuller ball, outside off. Alex Lees drives it towards the fielder at cover.
Touch fuller, around the fifth stump line, at 124 clicks. Alex Lees does not fiddle with it.
Another length delivery, swinging away outside off. Alex Lees offers no shot to that.
Shaping away, outside off, on a length. Alex Lees lets that go through to the keeper.
On a length, around middle. Jonny Bairstow blocks it out.

Angling in, on a length, on the thigh pads. Jonny Bairstow looks to tuck this away but he misses. The ball rolls towards short leg. Alex Lees leaves his crease as he wanted a single there, but Jonny Bairstow sends back mid-way. Good call from Jonny Bairstow!
Another quick single! Fullish delivery, outside off. Alex Lees drives it towards the right of the mid off fielder and runs across to the other end.
Angling in, around middle and leg, on a length. Jonny Bairstow tucks it toward mid-wicket and scampers through to the other end
Another fuller ball, outside off. Alex Lees leans and drives it past cover for a single.
Fuller ball, outside off, shaping away. Alex Lees leaves it alone.
Alzarri Joseph (4-1-11-0) comes back into the attack.
This is a length ball, well outside off. Jonny Bairstow leaves it alone. Yet another maiden over from Holder!
On a good length, around off. Jonny Bairstow dabs it onto the deck.
A well-directed bumper from Holder, around leg. Jonny Bairstow looks to pull at first but ends up swaying away from the line of the delivery.
A full ball, on middle. Jonny Bairstow covers the line of the ball and pushes it towards mid on.
Back of a length, jagging back in from outside off. Jonny Bairstow keeps it out.
This is a length ball, around the fifth stump channel. Jonny Bairstow gets forward and blocks it.
Another ball, shorter in length, around off. Alex Lees dabs it onto the deck.
Short of a length, around off. Alex Lees defends it to the off side.
Edged and Four! Good-length ball, around off and angling across the batter, Alex Lees has a poke at it. It takes the outside edge and runs past the diving fielder at gully for a boundary.
Fuller in length, outside off. Alex Lees pushes it to the man at mid off.
A very full ball, outside off. Alex Lees fails to dig it out.
On a length and angling across the batter. Alex Lees leaves it alone.
Good-length delivery, around off. Jonny Bairstow pushes it to the off side.
Sharp bounce there! Back of a length, nipping back in late from outside off. Jonny Bairstow shoulders arms to it but the ball jags back sharply and hits him on his thigh pad.
BEAUTY! This one comes in with the angle and straightens just that little bit after landing. Jonny Bairstow looks to defend but the ball goes past his outside edge.
Holder runs in and serves a length ball, around the fifth stump channel. Jonny Bairstow defends it towards cover.
Good-length delivery, angling in from off. Jonny Bairstow misses his flick and gets hit on his thigh pad.
Short of a length, around off. Jonny Bairstow hangs back and gets solid in his front foot defence.
An overpitched ball, around middle and leg. Jonny Bairstow tickles it to fine leg and settles for a run.
Back of a length, outside off. Jonny Bairstow stays back and slashes hard but fails to get any bat on it.
This is on a length, around off. Jonny Bairstow defends it towards cover-point.
A full ball, around off. Jonny Bairstow blocks it to the off side.
On a length, around off. Jonny Bairstow looks to drive on the up but it goes off the inner half of the bat towards the on side.
Back of a length, around off. Jonny Bairstow covers his off pole and keeps it out.
Nice and full, outside off. Alex Lees leans and pushes it towards mid off.
Back of a length, around off. Alex Lees hangs back and tucks it towards mid on.
Good-length delivery, coming in with the angle from off. Alex Lees gets forward and defends it.
Pitches it up, outside off. Alex Lees defends it towards cover.
Bye! A length ball, outside off and staying a touch low. Jonny Bairstow lets it be. Jonny Bairstow behind the sticks, fails to grab the ball cleanly and the batters sneak in a bye.
Holder serves a full ball, on middle. Jonny Bairstow prods and drives it to the mid on fielder.
A length ball, angling in from 'round the wicket, around middle. Alex Lees blocks it out.
Length delivery, outside off. Alex Lees leaves it alone.
On a length, outside off. Jonny Bairstow looks to push this away on the off side, but the ball goes off the inside edge towards fine leg for a single.
Fuller delivery again, around middle, at 134 clicks. Jonny Bairstow drives it towards the right of the fielder at mid on. No run taken!
Angling in, outside off, fuller in length. Jonny Bairstow lunges and defends it out solidly.
Another halt in play. Once again, the crowd near the sight screen is troubling the battters. The umpire is requesting them to sit down.
Jayden Seales pitches it up, outside off. Jonny Bairstow drives and finds the fielder at cover.
Swinging away, on a length, outside off. Alex Lees leaves it alone.
Alzarri Joseph drops it short again, outside off. Alex Lees dabs it towards point off the back foot.
Another shorter ball, outside off. Jonny Bairstow hangs back and pushes it towards point for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Alex Lees taps it towards point and scampers through to the other end.
Much fuller on this occasion, outside off. Alex Lees leans and drives it to the fielder at cover.
Fraction short now, outside off. Alex Lees defends it out watchfully.
On a length, around off. Jonny Bairstow defends it out.
Another good-length delivery, this one comes back in, around middle. Jonny Bairstow looks to glance this away, but he misses and gets rapped on th thigh pads.
A length delivery, around middle and leg. Alex Lees works it away through square leg and rotates the strike.
Full again, outside off. Alex Lees drives it towards the fielder at cover.
Overpitched delivery once again, around middle. Alex Lees pushes it back to the bowler.
Very full, around middle and leg. Jonny Bairstow flicks it past square leg for a single.
Shorter ball, shaping away, outside off. Alex Lees leaves it alone.
On a length, around off. Alex Lees blocks it out watchfully.
Back of a length, around off. Alex Lees hops and defends it out solidly.
Tailing in, on a length, around middle and leg. Jonny Bairstow tucks it towards square leg and rotates the strike.
Angling in on a fuller length, outside off. Jonny Bairstow defends this one off the front foot.
FOUR! Lovey shot! Perfectly timed shot! A good-length delivery, outside off. Jonny Bairstow opens the face of the bat and guides it past gully for a boundary.
Good-length delivery, shaping away, outside off. Alex Lees leaves it alone. Another maiden over from Kemar Roach!
Fuller delivery, nipping back in, around middle. Alex Lees defends it out.
Beaten! Lovely delivery by Kemar Roach! This one lands on a length angles in and the shapes away, outside off. Alex Lees looks to block this but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Swinging away now outside off, length delivery. Alex Lees leaves that alone.
Angling in around off, on a length. Alex Lees stays in his crease and defends it out.
On a length, outside off, at 128 kph. Alex Lees leans and blocks it towards cover.
Play and a miss! This is full and well outside off. Jonny Bairstow looks for a booming drive through cover but he fails to get any bat on it.
Short of a length, around off. Jonny Bairstow keeps it out.

FOUR! Short and wide, outside off. Bairstow sits back in his crease and cuts it through the cover-point region. The ball races away to the fence. A welcome boundary for England as they bring up their 50!
Back of a length, around off. Jonny Bairstow hangs back and dabs it onto the deck.
On a length and jagging back in from middle. Jonny Bairstow gets cramped for room as he wrists it towards mid-wicket.
Back of a length, outside off. Jonny Bairstow looks to punch it through cover but it goes off the inner half of the blade towards cover.
A length ball, angling in late from middle. Jonny Bairstow tucks it to the leg side for a single.
A full ball, outside off. Jonny Bairstow defends it to the off side.
On a length, around middle. Jonny Bairstow keeps it out.
A full ball, outside off. Jonny Bairstow drives it to the mid off fielder.
Fuller in length, outside off. Jonny Bairstow mistimes his drive towards the cover fielder.
A full ball, well outside off. Alex Lees taps it past the cover fielder and takes a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Jonny Bairstow lets it sail through to the keeper. Alzarri Joseph starts with a maiden over!
Shorter in length, outside off. Jonny Bairstow punches it to the cover fielder.
On a length and outside off. Jonny Bairstow leaves it alone.
Back of a length, around off. Jonny Bairstow keeps it out.
Good-length ball, around middle. Jonny Bairstow tucks it to mid-wicket.
Back of a length, angling in from outside off. Jonny Bairstow looks to flick but he misses and gets hit high on his pad.
Fuller in length, outside off. Alex Lees looks to drive but it goes off the inner half of the blade towards fine leg for a brace.
BEATEN! A bit full, just outside off and nipping back in sharply. Alex Lees looks to drive but the ball sneaks through his bat and pad.
On a length, just outside off. Alex Lees shoulders his arms at this one.
Back of a length, well outside off. Alex Lees lets it be.
Fuller in length, outside off. Alex Lees leaves it alone.
A full ball, outside off. Alex Lees squeezes it out to cover.
We are back for the final session of the day! The players are out in the middle. Alex Lees and Jonny Bairstow will resume their innings. Kemar Roach will begin with the ball. Here we go...
... Day 3, Session 3 ...

Right then! West Indies still lead by 50 runs. They will look to pick the remaining 6 wickets as early as possible. Things are a little tough for England but for now, they need to rebuild and Alex Lees and Jonny Bairstow need to stick around till the end of the day at least. We have an exciting final session coming up which begins at 12:30 am IST (7:00 pm GMT, previous day). Stay tuned!

West Indies bowlers are breathing fire at the moment, Kyle Mayers, in particular. Jayden Seales began the proceedings by grabbing the wicket of Zak Crawley, and since then it's been only Kyle Mayers leading the charge. He was been very disciplined with his bowling and has been rewarded with three wickets. Coming into this session West Indies were in a comfortable position but at the end of this session, they are in a commanding position. Top-order of England has failed once again. However, Alex Lees is the batter who is at the crease since the very first over, he is looking settled for now but he will want to carry on till the end of the day along with Jonny Bairstow at the other end. England trail only by 50 runs, but it still feels a long way to go for them. We did witness the lower-order of England chipping in with vital runs at the end of the first innings, so they do have batting left but they cannot afford to lose more wickets.

What a session this has been for West Indies! A lead of 93 was always looking tough for England. The hosts are well in control of this game, whereas England are not having the best day in the office! They will be disappointed with their effort with the bat thus far.
Good-length delivery, around off. Jonny Bairstow prods and defends it to the off side. That will be Tea on Day 3!
Slightly shorter in length, angling in from off. Jonny Bairstow sits back and defends it.
Back of a length, outside off. Jonny Bairstow stays back and punches it through the cover region for a brace.
Good-length delivery, around off. Jonny Bairstow keeps it out.
A full ball, around off. Jonny Bairstow squeezes it out towards cover.
On a length, outside off. Jonny Bairstow prods and leaves it alone.
On a length, outside off. Alex Lees lets it be.
A length ball, angling in late from off. Alex Lees looks to flick but he gets an inside edge onto his pad.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Jonny Bairstow pushes it towards cover and takes a single.

Almost chopped on! Very full again, outside off. Alex Lees tries to dig this one out, but the ball goes off the inside edge just missing the off pole. It rolls towards the right of the keeper towards fine leg for a single.
On a length now, angling in around middle. Alex Lees pushes it towards mid on.
Very full this time, around offf. Alex Lees pushes it towards mid off.
Kemar Roach (4-3-2-0) is back on.
Fraction shorter, angling in, around middle. Jonny Bairstow defends it out solidly. Two maidens in a row for West Indies!
Angling in, on a length, around middle. Jonny Bairstow tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Tad fuller, outside off. Jonny Bairstow drives it towards the fielder at cover-point.
On a length delivery, angling in, around off. Jonny Bairstow pushes it towards cover.
Beaten! Good-length delivery, outside off, swinging away a tad. Jonny Bairstow looks to have a poke at it but he misses.
Length delivery, outside off. Jonny Bairstow does not fiddle with it.
Tad fuller, jagging back in sharply, around off. Alex Lees lunges and defends it out. A maiden over by Jason Holder!
Another good-length delivery, outside off, tailing back in sharply. Alex Lees shoulders his arms at it.
Nipping back in from a length, outside off. Alex Lees lets that go through.
Another length delivery, outside off. Alex Lees offers no shot to that.
On a length, outside off. Alex Lees taps it towards point.
Tight leave from Alex Lees! A length ball, nipping back in sharply, around off. Alex Lees leaves it alone and the ball goes just over the off pole.
Good-length delivery, around off. Jonny Bairstow keeps it out watchfully.
Fuller in length, outside off. Jonny Bairstow leaves it alone.
On a length and jagging back in sharply, from middle. Jonny Bairstow misses his flick and gets hit on his pad.
Jonny Bairstow walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Kyle Mayers is breathing fire at the moment! England have lost their fourth, and Kyle Mayers grabs his third wicket. The visitors are all over the place. This was a shorter ball, outside off, a hint of away movement. Ben Stokes was in two minds whether to play that or leave it. He decides to leave the ball and lifts his bat a tad late. The ball tickles his toe-end and goes behind the sticks towards Shamarh Brooks who pouches it safely. Ben Stokes walks back early.
Commentary.Howout: c Shamarh Brooks b Kyle Mayers

Commentary.Commentary: DROPPED! A chance goes down! It's Kyle Mayers once again creating opportunities. This was a fuller ball, shaping away, outside off. Alex Lees leans and looks to drive this but the ball goes off the outside edge towards Nkrumah Bonner at gully. He dives to his left, gets his hand to it but fails to grab it. A single taken!
Fuller ball, angling in, around off. Alex Lees defends it out off the front foot.

The physio is out there and it is Joshua Da Silva who continues to have some pain in his finger. He is walking off the field. Shamarh Brooks has the gloves on and he will keep wickets for West Indies.
Fuller now, swinging in, around middle. Ben Stokes drives and finds the fielder at mid off.
Length delivery, angling in, around middle. Ben Stokes clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Quick single! On a length, outside off. Alex Lees pushes it towards mid off and scampers through to the other end.
Ta fuller now, outside off. Alex Lees leans and drives it past cover for a couple of runs.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Alex Lees presses forward and defends it out.

Fuller in length, outside off. Alex Lees drags it back to the bowler.
Good-length ball, angling in from middle. Alex Lees tucks it to mid-wicket.
Fuller in length, jagging back in from outside off. Alex Lees lets it be.
BEATEN! Good-length ball, just outside off and shaping away late. Alex Lees looks to defend but the ball beats his outside edge.
Stokes skips down the track and flicks this full ball wide of mid on for a single.
A full ball, well outside off. Ben Stokes does not offer any shot to that one.
A bit fuller, around off. Alex Lees defends it out watchfully.
A slower ball, on a length, outside off. Alex Lees lets it through to the keeper.
An overpitched ball, outside off. Alex Lees digs it out towards the gully fielder.
A full ball, outside off. Ben Stokes defends it to the off side and rotates the strike.
This is a length ball, angling in late from off. Ben Stokes prods and dabs it onto the deck.
Fuller in length, outside off. Ben Stokes leaves it alone.
Short of a length, nipping back in from middle. Ben Stokes tickles it to fine leg and settles for a single.
Mayers drags his length back, outside off. Ben Stokes pushes it to cover.
Good-length delivery, just outside off. Stokes gets to the pitch of the ball and blocks it.
Full and outside off. Ben Stokes drives it to the mid off fielder.
Fuller in length, outside off. Ben Stokes shoulders his arms at it.
Back of a length, around off. Ben Stokes stays back and dabs it onto the deck.
Fuller in length, outside off. Alex Lees prods and defends it to the off side.
Holder bangs it into the deck, around off. Alex Lees ducks underneath.
Good-length delivery, around off. Alex Lees keeps it out.
Back of a length, angling in from well outside off. Alex Lees hangs back and sways his bat away from the line of the ball.
On a length, around off. Alex Lees keeps it out watchfully.
A full ball, outside off. Alex Lees does not bother playing at that one.
Jason Holder comes into the attack.
An appeal for LBW but the umpire says no! Short of a length, nipping back in from outside off. Ben Stokes skips down the track and looks to block but he misses and gets hit high on his pad.
FOUR BYES! That stayed very low! A length ball, way outside off and staying low. Ben Stokes leaves it alone. Joshua Da Silva behind the sticks, fails to grab the ball and it races away to the fence.
Good-length ball, well outside off. Ben Stokes lets it through to the keeper.

DRINKS! What a start this has been for West Indies! They have managed to grab three big wickets and they are all over England at the moment. The visitors are in all sorts of trouble now. They need a partnership to turn things around. Ben Stokes walks out to bat.

OUT! TIMBER! KYLE MAYERS ON THE MARCH! He is once again turning the game on its head with his bowling. England's top order fails to deliver yet again! This was a good-length ball, just outside off and jagging back in late. Dan Lawrence walks across to his off pole and shoulders his arms at it, but the ball nips back in and crashes into the off pole. Dan Lawrence stands there in disbelief but then takes the long walk back to the pavilion.
Pitches it up, outside off. Dan Lawrence drives it to the mid off fielder.
This is a length ball, around middle. Dan Lawrence keeps it out.
Fraction shorter, around middle. Alex Lees stays in his crease and punches it towards mid on.
Much fuller now, outside off. Alex Lees does not fiddle with it.
Outside off, on a length. Alex Lees leaves it alone.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Alex Lees walks across and taps it defends it out.
This one shapes away, from outside off, touch short in length. Alex Lees taps it towards point.
Fraction shorter, angling in, around middle. Alex Lees defends it out.
On a length, angling in, around middle. Dan Lawrence defends it out. End of a successful first over by Kyle Mayers!
Pitches it up again, around middle. Dan Lawrence drives and finds the fielder at mid on.
Fuller ball, around off. Dan Lawrence pushes it towards cover.
Dan Lawrence walks in at number 4.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Kyle Mayers has done it once again! He has got rid of Joe Root yet again in this match. That is a big, big wicket. England in trouble early on! Kyle Mayers delivers this on a shorter length, outside off and shaping away a tad. Joe Root stands tall and looks to punch this through cover, but the ball goes off the outside edge towards John Campbell at first slip, who takes a sharp catch by moving quickly to his right.
Commentary.Howout: c John Campbell b Kyle Mayers

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter ball, outside off. Joe Root leaves it alone.
Shorter ball, outside off. Joe Root stays back and steers it towards third man for a single.
FOUR BYES! Bonus runs for England! Shorter ball, wide of off. Alex Lees leaves it alone, and Joshua Da Silva fails to stop the ball cleanly. The ball races away behind him for a boundary.
Good-length delivery, angling in, on the pads. Alex Lees flicks it towards mid-wicket.

Jayden Seales goes 'round the wicket now, serves a length delivery, outside off. Alex Lees leaves it alone.
Angling in, on a length, around the leg pole. Joe Root tucks it through square leg for a single.
Beaten! On a length, outside off, swinging away a tad. Joe Root stays in his crease and looks to block this but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Pitches it up, angling in, around middle and leg. Alex Lees works it away towards mid-wicket. A maiden over by Kemar Roach!

Another length delivery, angling in, around off. Alex Lees shows the full face of the bat and defends it out.
Nkrumah Bonner is walking off the field as something seems to have gone in his left eye.
Full in length, outside off. Alex Lees presses forward and blocks it out watchfully.
Good-length delivery, shaping away just a tad, around off. Alex Lees stays in his crease and looks to block this but the ball goes off the outside edge towards gully.
Fuller ball, around off. Alex Lees drives it to the fielder at cover.
Another outswinger, outside off, on a length, at 132 clicks. Joe Root offers no shot.

Back of a length, outside off. Joe Root leaves it alone. Jayden Seales continues to impress, a wicket-maiden from him!
Joe Root the skipper of England, walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Jayden Seales gets the breakthrough and England lose their opener early on, yet again! Exactly what West Indies would have hoped for! Seales serves a full ball, just outside off, inviting the batter to drive. Zak Crawley looks to drive through cover. It takes the outside edge as the ball shapes away a tad. The ball goes straight to Jason Holder at second slip who does the rest.
Commentary.Howout: c Jason Holder b Jayden Seales

Good-length ball, outside off. Zak Crawley lets it through to the keeper.

A stifled appeal for LBW but turned down! Back of a length, nipping back in late from off. Zak Crawley looks to block but he misses and gets pinged high on his pad. Height might have been the issue there.
On a length, around off. Zak Crawley gets forward and defends it solidly.
Seales starts with a full ball, outside off. Zak Crawley pushes it to the mid off fielder, off the front foot.
Jayden Seales will bowl from the other end.
A full ball, outside off. Alex Lees prods and drives it to the cover fielder.
On a length, well outside off and shaping away late. Alex Lees does not offer any shot to that one.
A full ball, around off. Alex Lees blocks it off the front foot.
Full and outside off. Alex Lees lets it be.
